notes.title: Gnarly Hike
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We are announcing the existence and approximate Release Date of Gnarly Hike and we couldn't be happier :)

Gnarly Hike is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore an eerie forest in a slow-paced, atmospheric world combining beautiful and horrifying scenery along with the constant fear of being hunted, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience. Uncover secrets, expel spirits and ...stay alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721753/fba3e5d0a76c631d0cf2c1e987bb60bfc9dadad7.gif[/img]

[h2]The Game in a nutshell...[/h2]

The game is set in a forest environment, filled with clues as to what is happening, as well as a Cabin, a Chapel, a Cave, a Hidden Burial Site and a Tower. You will have to investigate all those locations in order to uncover the dark secrets the forest holds, while being hunted by a powerful beast!

[h2]Demo and Full Release Dates[/h2]

We plan on releasing sometime in mid-December this year!
However, a 30-min demo is coming in the next couple of weeks so stay tuned and
Wishlist for more...!
